articles.title: Shared evidence, different recommendations: a comparative analysis of Qdenga (TAK-003) dengue vaccine guidance for travellers across countries

en.research_question: How do national advisory organizations differ in their policy recommendations for administering the Qdenga dengue vaccine to international travelers?
en.study_design: A comparative policy analysis that evaluated publicly accessible national guidelines alongside survey responses from health advisory committees.
en.population_setting: Public health advisory bodies representing seventeen nations, primarily non-endemic regions where the vaccine holds formal licensing approval.
en.main_findings: National directives consistently exceeded regulatory permissions in restrictiveness while demonstrating uniform support for individuals with confirmed past infections. Eligibility criteria for travelers lacking documented infection history showed substantial cross-border variation based on inconsistent application of exposure metrics and host susceptibility factors. Protocols also diverged regarding infection verification methods and pre-departure dosing schedules.
en.public_health_relevance: Inconsistent international protocols complicate clinical counseling and traveler preparedness for dengue-endemic destinations. Harmonizing future advisories will likely depend on supplementary effectiveness data targeting specific demographic groups currently underrepresented in clinical trials. Maintaining transparent dialogue between providers and patients remains critical amid these policy discrepancies.
en.limitations: The investigation synthesizes existing policy documents and committee surveys rather than measuring direct clinical outcomes or population-level vaccination coverage. Interpretive disparities stem from inherent differences between controlled trial cohorts and real-world travel demographics.
en.gids_interpretation: The manuscript demonstrates how identical foundational research can produce divergent regulatory pathways when expert panels navigate evidentiary gaps differently. It provides context for understanding guideline heterogeneity without implying changes in underlying pathogen circulation or novel safety signals.

It establishes a foundational reference for analyzing demographic shifts in disease incidence and informs broader discussions on managing health metrics across transient populations.

zh.study_design: 研究基于国家传染病监测系统数据，采用描述性分析方法对十年间的确诊病例进行回顾性统计。
zh.population_setting: 分析对象为韩国境内报告的急性乙型肝炎患者，核心关注点为外籍感染人群及其来源地分布。
zh.main_findings: 外籍患者的发病年龄普遍早于本土居民，且主要来源于乙肝高流行率的亚洲地区。多数感染者处于非熟练劳动状态，黄疸为常见症状，但免疫接种记录普遍缺失，流调过程常遇语言沟通困难。
zh.public_health_relevance: 鉴于外籍常住人口数量上升，该群体在传染病防控体系中占据重要位置。明确其免疫空白状况有助于规划定向的健康促进项目。

articles.title: Mpox in people with past infection or a complete vaccination course: a global case series

en.research_question: The investigation examines clinical manifestations and disease progression among individuals who have previously contracted the virus or finished a full immunization schedule.
en.study_design: Authors performed a descriptive global case series by compiling retrospective information from partner organizations spanning nine nations.
en.population_setting: The cohort comprised gay and bisexual men who have sex with men distributed internationally, specifically filtering for participants with verified prior infection or two-dose vaccination protocols initiated after the 2022 outbreak began.
en.main_findings: Within the tracked group of thirty-seven cases, individuals relying on natural immunity experienced condensed illness timelines and reduced mucosal symptoms during subsequent exposures. Patients completing vaccination regimens displayed minimal lesion counts, low analgesic dependence, and primarily outpatient care without fatalities. Observational comparisons indicated attenuated clinical severity relative to earlier outbreak records.
en.public_health_relevance: Cataloging symptom profiles in previously immune populations aids researchers in understanding how prior exposure modifies disease presentation within affected networks.
en.limitations: The analysis relies on a restricted cohort of thirty-seven participants and employs a purely observational framework without comparative control groups. Dependence on standardized reporting templates from external collaborators may introduce variability in data consistency.
en.gids_interpretation: This manuscript serves as an academic reference documenting clinical outcomes within a defined immunological subgroup during a specific temporal window. It provides historical context for scholarly discourse on orthopoxvirus behavior rather than indicating ongoing monitoring activities.

articles.title: Potential determinants of the decline in mpox cases in Belgium: A behavioral, epidemiological and seroprevalence study

en.research_question: What epidemiological, behavioral, and immunological factors influenced the reduction of mpox infections in Belgium during 2022?
en.study_design: Researchers combined national surveillance records, a prospective clinical registry, a survey of HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis recipients, and serial antibody testing across four 2022 intervals to assess changing trends.
en.population_setting: The analysis examined Belgian mpox cases alongside a cohort of individuals receiving HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis to evaluate risk profiles and immune status.
en.main_findings: Individuals diagnosed later in the period exhibited lower engagement in high-risk sexual activities compared to those identified initially. Antibody levels remained stable prior to vaccine distribution, and surveyed prophylaxis users reported consistent sexual habits. These observations suggest that shifts in immunity or reported conduct do not fully account for the declining case counts.
en.public_health_relevance: Documenting how case demographics and risk behaviors evolve during an outbreak assists public health planning by clarifying which factors may or may not drive epidemic resolution.
en.limitations: The investigators state that documented shifts in population immunity and self-reported conduct appear inadequate to account for the epidemic's decline. The reliance on registry records and survey responses may also limit comprehensive assessment of broader community transmission patterns.
en.gids_interpretation: This article offers historical context regarding mpox trend fluctuations in a European region, detailing how patient characteristics shifted over time. It functions as archival reference material for understanding previous outbreak phases rather than reflecting active monitoring efforts.

zh.study_design: 该研究采用观察性设计，整合了国家监测记录与单中心前瞻性队列数据，并结合针对特定人群的横断面问卷调查与多时间点血清学检测。
zh.population_setting: 研究样本主要来源于2022年比利时境内的确诊病例登记档案，并额外纳入了接受艾滋病暴露前预防药物治疗的个体作为行为与免疫指标的观察对象。
zh.main_findings: 疫情后期确诊者的性行为风险特征较早期病例有所降低，但目标预防用药人群的行为模式保持稳定。疫苗接种推广前抗体阳性率未见显著攀升，研究认为就诊人群特征的转变可能是推动病例数下降的因素之一。
